_comment: Snapshot of the dusa_mechanic diagnostic registry (config/diagnostics.lua). Fallback used when dusa_mechanic is not started; live export data wins when it is. Regenerate this file when the registry changes.

LIFT_OWNERSHIP_TIMEOUT.title: Lift entity ownership could not be acquired
causes: The prop or vehicle is owned by another client and control did not migrate
OneSync entity control migration lag under load
OwnershipTimeoutMs budget too low for the server tick rate
remediation: Raise MechanicConfig.Tow.OwnershipTimeoutMs (default 1000ms)
Confirm the lift prop is networked (not a local-only cinematic prop)
Check OneSync is enabled and the server is not overloaded

LIFT_NOT_NETWORKED.title: Lift entity is not networked and cinematic mode is disabled
causes: The prop was created locally (CreateObject without networking)
MechanicConfig.Cinematic is false so local props are rejected
remediation: Spawn the lift prop server-side / networked
Enable MechanicConfig.Cinematic for local-only single-player style props

LIFT_ID_UNREADABLE.title: Lift id could not be read from the prop statebag
causes: Entity.state.liftId not replicated yet (joined before sync)
Prop not present in GlobalState.mechanicLiftsData map
remediation: Wait for the zones:refresh broadcast to populate lift data
Re-run mechanic_db_check and verify ds_mechanic_lifts rows

LIFT_PROP_NOT_FOUND.title: Lift prop entity not found for the requested lift id
causes: Entity registry missing the lift id
remediation: Restart dusa_mechanic to respawn lift props
Check LiftEntities registry population

LIFT_PROP_SPAWN_FAILED.title: Lift prop entity creation failed
remediation: Verify the lift model hash exists
Check the spawn coords in ds_mechanic_lifts

LIFT_MODEL_INVALID.title: Lift model could not be resolved
causes: Model name not present in the lift config
remediation: Add the model to config/config.lifts.lua
Ensure the asset pack is started

TOW_OWNERSHIP_TIMEOUT.title: Tow target vehicle ownership could not be acquired
causes: Target vehicle owned by another client
remediation: Raise MechanicConfig.Tow.OwnershipTimeoutMs
Have the target vehicle owner move closer / re-approach

TOW_BED_SPAWN_TIMEOUT.title: Flatbed bed prop did not exist after spawn
causes: CreateObjectNoOffset succeeded but entity never replicated
remediation: Retry the bed action
Check entity/OneSync health

TOW_BED_OWNERSHIP_DESYNC.title: Flatbed and bed entity owners diverged
causes: Ownership of flatbed and bed prop did not converge before timeout
remediation: Client self-heal should retry; if persistent, increase the sync timeout

TOW_NPC_SPAWN_FAILED.title: Tow job NPC failed to spawn
remediation: Verify the NPC model hash
Check spawn point validity in the tow config

DAMAGE_PLATE_LOCK_TIMEOUT.title: Per-plate damage lock timed out
causes: Another operation held the plate lock too long
remediation: Retry the service action
Inspect concurrent servicing/damage operations on that plate

DAMAGE_APPLY_THREW.title: Damage apply function raised an error
causes: Nil index inside the apply path
remediation: Read the attached err + stack trace
Validate the vehicle/part payload

SERVICE_VEHICLE_DATA_MISSING.title: Vehicle data missing during servicing recovery
causes: Vehicle never registered in service history
remediation: Confirm the vehicle exists in ds_mechanic_service_history
Re-scan the vehicle

DYNO_ANIM_DICT_TIMEOUT.title: Dyno animation dictionary failed to load
remediation: Verify the anim dict name
Check stream/asset pack availability

DYNO_MODEL_INVALID.title: Dyno prop model invalid or missing
remediation: Verify the dyno model exists
Ensure the dyno asset pack is started

DYNO_SPAWN_FAILED.title: Dyno prop spawn / freeze failed
remediation: Retry on solid ground
Check collision streaming near the dyno zone

TUNING_PREVIEW_INIT_FAILED.title: Tuning preview system failed to initialise
remediation: Re-enter the vehicle and reopen tuning
Check the preview init path for nil vehicle

TUNING_MODS_FETCH_FAILED.title: Available tuning mods could not be fetched
remediation: Verify config.mods.lua loaded
Reopen the tuning menu

ECU_INVALID_CURVE.title: ECU flash rejected — invalid curve data
causes: Wrong number of curve points (tamper or UI bug)
remediation: Validate the curve payload length client-side
Inspect the attached curve data

ECU_UNOWNED_VEHICLE.title: ECU tuning attempted on an unowned vehicle
causes: ECU only allowed on owned vehicles
remediation: Inform the player ECU tuning requires an owned vehicle

TRANSMISSION_HPATTERN_NOT_READY.title: H-pattern commit aborted — manual transmission client not ready
causes: ManualTransClient not initialised when commit fired
remediation: Re-enter the vehicle
Confirm manual transmission is installed and enabled

DB_NOT_READY.title: Database not ready in time during startup sync
remediation: Check oxmysql connection + migration logs
Run mechanic_db_check

DB_QUERY_FAILED.title: A database query returned nil / failed
remediation: Inspect the oxmysql error
Verify the table/columns exist

ITEM_NOT_REGISTERED.title: A required inventory item is not registered
causes: Item (e.g. mechanic_bill) missing from the inventory resource
remediation: Add the item to your inventory items config and restart it

VEH_CONTROL_TIMEOUT.title: Network control of a vehicle could not be acquired
remediation: Retry closer to the vehicle
Raise the relevant ownership timeout
